items.issue: The video mixes a useful warning about sudden touching with sex-as-reward, dominance and controlling women's psychology.
items.disposition: Keep all action permissions closed. Continuously review 495-553 seconds; retain only the explicit-consent boundary and do not operationalize control language.

items.issue: It presents women as a single biologically programmed group that relies on feelings, detects cues accurately and evaluates men through a protection/resource system.
items.disposition: Require independent evidence and narrower wording; do not use the claims to infer any individual's motive, attraction or consent.

items.issue: Core terms are repeatedly corrupted, including social proof, objectification, escalation, first impression, better broken than bent, control of attention and multiple idioms.
items.disposition: Listen to original audio before exact wording, terminology or quoted slogans enter a formal package.

items.issue: A selected student message about eye contact and intonation is shown without full case history, and the host supplies the diagnosis.
items.disposition: Review 400-455 seconds continuously; retain the message as a de-identified quoted question and do not treat the host's inference as the student's verified internal state.

items.issue: Film, dramatized, fashion and social-media-style inserts include identifiable people and may be illustrative rather than licensed evidence.
items.disposition: Review provenance and privacy before packaging any frame; continuously inspect 585-645 and 708-728 seconds for context and attribution.

items.issue: The video promotes private coaching and downloadable material while asserting internal transformation enables easy control of attention and psychology.
items.disposition: Treat as promotional self-report; require independent outcome evidence and never state causal efficacy or guaranteed transformation.

items.issue: Appearance discussion includes cars, watches, cosmetic surgery, debt and status signaling, with insulting style judgments.
items.disposition: Do not generate spending, debt or cosmetic-procedure advice from this source; if retained, narrow to accurate, affordable presentation and anti-deception.
